Three, engage with community garden groups and urge them to plant native milkweeds and nectar producing plants. Four, engage with gardening leaders and partners to support Monarch Butterfly conservation. Five, create a community art project to enhance and promote Monarch and pollinator conservation, as well as cultural awareness and recognition.
